name: three-tier-pricing-table
title: Three Tier Pricing Table
description: Comparative SaaS pricing table layout with vertical plan columns and horizontal feature checkmark rows.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Three Tier Plan Matrix: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
